#: A message box that the session ends under (run.py --cases message-overlay --script scripts/message_box_exit.json --ini ini/own_frames.ini --expect expect/message_overlay_exit.json). The runtime's EXITING arrives while the box is up and nothing has answered it: the call returns ApplicationQuit (6) on its own, not by the watchdog's close, with no frame call out of order.
